Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations

Class DatabaseMigrationRepository

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.DatabaseMigrationRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
MigrationRepository
public final class DatabaseMigrationRepository extends Object implements MigrationRepository
Keeps the migrations table through a Schema and its connection.

The table has Laravel's layout: an auto-increment id, a unique migration name of up to 191 characters, a batch number and a nullable checksum of up to 64 characters, last. The schema builder creates, checks and drops it; reads and writes are plain SQL with every value sent as a binding, and only the checked table name is part of the SQL text.

Instances are immutable and as safe to share between threads as the connection they use.

Tested against SQLite. The reads use limit, so SQL Server and Oracle are not supported yet.

Implementation Note:
Inside Connection.pretend(org.aristonis.diwan.database.PretendCallback) nothing reaches the database, so reads return empty results and repositoryExists() returns false. Read the repository outside the pretend callback.

    • DatabaseMigrationRepository

      public DatabaseMigrationRepository(Schema schema)
      Creates a repository on the "migrations" table.
      Parameters:
      schema - the schema builder of the connection that holds the table, never null; the connection's table prefix is added to the name
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if schema is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the prefixed name breaks the rule of DatabaseMigrationRepository(Schema, String)

    • DatabaseMigrationRepository

      public DatabaseMigrationRepository(Schema schema, String table)
      Creates a repository on a named table.
      Parameters:
      schema - the schema builder of the connection that holds the table, never null; the connection's table prefix is added to the name
      table - the table name without prefix, never null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the prefixed name is not lowercase letters, digits and underscores starting with a letter or underscore, or is longer than 63 characters

    • log

      public void log(String name, int batch, String checksum)
      Records that a migration ran.
      Specified by:
      log in interface MigrationRepository
      Parameters:
      name - the migration name, never null; non-blank, at most 191 characters, without control characters
      batch - the batch number, at least 1
      checksum - the checksum the migration declared, or null to record none, which the migrator never checks
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the table has no checksum column because it was created before checksums existed; the message gives the one statement to run
